title: Fee Deductions, Fee Credits and Buyer Refund Debits on the Northloop Payments Balance
content:
**Rule.** Every billed selling fee and FBN fee is deducted from the Northloop Payments balance on its billing date, and every fee credit is returned to it. Every buyer refund funded by the seller is debited from the balance on the refund date; refunds funded by Northloop are never debited. Deductions and debits apply even when they take the balance below zero; the date the balance first goes below zero is recorded as the negative-since date and cleared when it returns to zero or more.

## Entry by entry

| Item | Effect on the balance | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Billed selling fee | deducted | its billing date |
| Billed FBN fee | deducted | its billing date |
| Fee credit | returned to the balance | — |
| Buyer refund funded by the seller | debited | the refund date |
| Buyer refund funded by Northloop | never debited | — |

## The negative-since date

- A deduction or debit is booked even when it takes the balance below zero.
- The negative-since date is the date the balance first goes below zero; it stays while the balance remains below zero and is cleared when the balance returns to zero or more.

*Hypothetical sequence.* A balance of 40.00 USD receives a selling fee deduction of 25.00 USD on day 1 (balance 15.00 USD) and a seller-funded refund debit of 60.00 USD on day 3 (balance minus 45.00 USD): the negative-since date is day 3. A fee credit of 50.00 USD on day 5 brings the balance to 5.00 USD and the negative-since date is cleared.
